description: Criteria data governance policy: who may load or change lender rules and how sources are dated
Product rule that outputs are indicative or refer only; prohibited decision wording list PT-01 reviewed by compliance
New lender onboarding checklist incl. data-sharing agreement and named lender criteria contact
Lender criteria held as versioned rules with source document and effective dates; criteria_engine validation must pass before load
Every rule change approved by the lender criteria contact and a second criteria analyst (four-eyes) before publication
Refer outcomes route the broker to the lender criteria contact; platform never converts refer to eligible
Daily job lists rules last verified more than 90 days ago and refers affected outcomes
Monthly MI of wrong-lender submissions reported by brokers against the 2% pilot guardrail
Weekly review of broker override and agreement rates to detect over-reliance
Quarterly sample of 30 rules re-checked against lender source documents by a reviewer outside the criteria team
Independent validation of the AI criteria explanation assistant (grounding refusal and fairness slices) before pilot
Internal audit of criteria data governance in the first pilot year
